author: Rhetic
body:
On March 28, 2016, 11:26:20 PM GMT, I was banned for using Hacks ( Anti-knockback, Forcefield ) by FrostedCupecakez. I believe that I was falsely banned because I don't know how to download any hacks, although this is not a valid excuse for my false ban, I am almost always lagging out on every server. My internet connection is always 3 to 2 bars. Why? I play in my basement, which is very far from the router in my house. Hopefully, you guys can understand my situation, whenever I hit someone I freeze up and players attack me at this time I lag and I usually end up somewhere close on the map for some reason as I freeze whilst swinging like 100 times without clicking anything because the response was probably delayed or something, but I'm not a genius on this, so maybe you guys can understand my situation. So, please take into the consideration that I do not hack and if you would like to contact me, please do so at sahib2hossain@gmail.com. I will eventually have to move closer to my router because on other servers, I have been banned for speed hacks and teleportation, unfortunately they didn't accept my false ban appeal because they have reason to believe I do hack. I really don't understand how my connection can make these things occur. However, I do honestly enjoy playing on the Avic.us server, especially the game where you capture the other team's monument and I wouldn't want to hack anytime because I just enjoy the mini game you guys have going on in this server. Hopefully, the Avicus staff and admins will understand my situation here as I do believe it is not a good excuse, but please consider my problem here. Thank you! 

 P.S. The only thing that I tweaked on my minecraft game is the texture pack. I don't download things like hacks because it can often cause viruses and make my computer very slow. I use 1.9 minecraft because my minecraft launcher updates automatically for some reason and I think the fact that you guys disabled 1.9 pvp is awesome! Hopefully this is the correct section that I should be posting this.....

title: iPotential [ Falsely Banned ]

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello iPotential,

I apologize for the wait for a response on your appeal. The evidence for your ban can be found here: https://youtu.be/0xfyII-LrTw
Senior staff members will review your appeal further and come to a final decision. If you have any questions, feel free to comment here and I will try my best to answer them to the best of my abilities.

Thank you for your patience.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez

replies.author: Rhetic
replies.body: Thank you for notifying me! That is exactly what people accuse me of and I can truly see how this can really be Anti-Knockback. When I hit a person makes me freeze up so I don't move. I am working on fixing this issue, but thank you for showing me this.

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello iPotential,

You had five bars at the time this occurred. During :45-:50 seconds in the video, you are shot with an arrow but however you do not take any knockback. I have discussed this with other members of the staff team and it is clear that you were using Antiknockback. 

I'm going to be denying this appeal. If you have any further questions, you may post them here until a senior staff member locks this discussion.

Thank you,
FrostedCupcakez
